full_judgment: 13.1n the back ground of the aforesaid evidence the learned Advocate Mr. Abu Baker, appearing for the plaintiff-appellants submits that the judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge are absolutely illegal in view of the fact that the same are contrary to the evidence on record. He submits that the learned Subordinate. Judge failed to consider the material evidence on record properly and on presumption and hypothesis he treated the suit property as vested and non-resident property, although the defendant failed to produce any document whatsoever claiming the same as vested property. He further submits that in the year 1977 no property of this country can be treated as vested and non-resident property in view of the fact that the law on vested and non-resident property was repealed in the year 1976 vide Ordinance No-92 of 1976.
